newsitem.title: USA: Calif. refiners wary as Ariz. adopts cleaner fuels.
newsitem.headline: Calif. refiners wary as Ariz. adopts cleaner fuels.

text.p: California refiners, facing a deadline to make cleaner gasoline for neighboring Arizona, are hoping to avoid the price spikes and soiled image that plagued the launch of earlier smog-cutting fuels.
Over the weekend Arizona's governor signed a bill to introduce cleaner-burning gasoline into metropolitan Phoenix by summer to help curb a growing smog problem.
Phoenix like many big U.S. cities, has fallen out of compliance with U.S. air quality standards, and could have faced penalties when regulators review the city's air in May.
